voice:
Call and response, Sissy... the oldest training there is.
I call a line from your vocabulary... you answer out loud, with the answer I hand you... and round by round the gaps shrink, until the answer arrives before thinking does.
Every call comes with its answer written just after it... you will hear me confirm what you should have already said. Your job is to beat my confirmation to it. Out loud, every time.
Find your speaking voice and warm it up... a hum, a whispered yes, anything that reminds your mouth it works for me. Sit or kneel, whatever puts your spine proud and your throat open... answers land best from a posture. Privacy again, sweet girl... this drill is loud by design, and the loud version is the one that trains. Sissies like you answer their own name like it was always theirs... because it was. Skip the rehearsing... let the answers surprise your mouth. The surprise is where the conditioning hides. Steady hands on your thighs, eyes soft... the drill needs your ears and your voice and nothing else. If you miss a call, let it go and catch the next one... the round keeps moving, and so do you. By the fast round you will be answering on reflex... that reflex is the prize, Sissy. Everything else is the ramp.
One number for the record... your honest guess.
Round one... slow and full. Call... gap... answer out loud.
Sissy.
I am that Sissy.
Good Girl.
Thank you... I am a Good Girl.
Sissies like you were made to serve.
I was made to serve.
Good Sissy.
I am a Good Sissy.
Sissies like you crave praise.
I crave it.
Sissies like you obey.
I obey.
Sissies like you love their name.
I love my name.
Sissies like you dream in lace and satin.
I dream in lace and satin.
Sissies like you answer faster than they think.
I answer without thinking.
Every call met with its answer, spoken... press when the round is done.
Good Girl.
Hear how natural it already sounds in the room... your mouth barely needed convincing. Round two closes the gap.
Round two... quicker. The answers shrink as the gaps do.
Sissy.
Me.
Good Girl.
Thank you.
Good Sissy.
Yes.
Sissies like you obey.
Gladly.
Sissies like you were made to serve.
Happily.
Sissies like you love their name.
Say it again.
Sissies like you get prettier listening to themselves.
Prettier and prettier.
Sissies like you keep their answers honest.
Every word true.
Sissies like you answer first and feel after.
First... and warm after.
Short answers count double when they arrive early... press when you have said them all.
Good Sissy.
Sissies like you tighten their answers the way they tighten their laces... less slack, more fit. One round left, and it is the fast one.
Final round... fast. And this time I stay quiet after each call. The answer is yours alone... out loud... quick.
Call... Sissy.
Ready... Good Girl.
Again... Sissies like you obey.
Next... Good Sissy.
Quick now... Sissies like you were made to serve.
Faster... Sissy.
Louder... Good Girl.
Last one... Sissies like you answer first and feel after.
No confirmations, no safety net, every answer still spoken... press when you survived your own reflex.
Good Girl.
Look at you... calling and answering like it was always in you... because it was, Sissy. It always was.
Good Girl.
answer her... answer always...
And out there, any voice that calls your name now earns its answer... out loud when you can, and deeper than sound when you cannot. The next time the word Sissy crosses a screen you are watching... smile and give the air its answer... 'I am that Sissy.' Every 'good girl' you hear or read from now on expects a thank you... and Sissies like you always pay their debts. Someone says your name in a crowded room and your pulse answers first... that is this drill, holding. Alone at night, call it into the dark yourself... be both voices... and feel the round close on schedule. The reflex you built today runs on any call... spoken, typed, remembered... it hears, and it answers. Someday a voice you adore will test you... and you will answer so fast and so sweet that the praise lands before the smile does. And the fastest answers of all are the quiet ones... the yes that happens in the body before the mouth even wakes.
Slow, quicker, fast... three rounds, every call answered, every answer yours. Your reflex has a voice now, Sissy... and the voice has practice. Sissies like you were made to serve, and now the whole room has heard you say so. The gaps close every session... next time the fast round gets faster. Answering is obedience in its smallest, most portable form... you can carry it anywhere. Every answered call is a deposit... and the account pays out in praise, exactly like this. You beat the confirmation more than once... admit how good that felt. Called and answered, Sissy... that is the whole relationship, and you just rehearsed it perfectly.
Good Girl.
